# Richard J. Reyes Research Archive

> Public discovery map for Wave Confinement Theory (WCT), related experiments, open-data analyses, computation, AI architecture, resonance-control research, and non-enabling patent-application summaries.

## Preferred website navigation
- Research home: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/
- Publications: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/publications/
- Patent application portfolio: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/patents/
- Equations and definitions: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/equations/
- Complete SymPy audit: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/sympy/
- Complete Lean coverage: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/lean/
- Research tools: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/tools/
- Equations and verification map: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/research-corpus/
- Claim-level priority registry: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/priority/

## Machine-readable resources

- Effective compiled registry: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/compiled-registry.json
- Registry validation report: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/registry-validation-report.json

- Claim-priority metadata: https://rickyjreyes.github.io/priority/priority.json

Use the internal website pages first because they preserve navigation, evidence boundaries, status labels, and backlinks. Repository files are the technical source layer.

## Resolution order
1. Resolve a publication through its exact DOI, claim IDs, equation IDs, assumptions, code, data, and evidence links when present.
2. Resolve a canonical equation through compiled-registry.json and its effective status.
3. Treat full_registry.yaml as the historical baseline when a derived override exists.
4. Resolve the effective SymPy classification and named checker.
5. Resolve Lean as a separate layer: theorem, definition, counterexample, partial support, TODO, or unmapped.
6. Resolve semantic links to papers, derivations, predictions, experiments, datasets, evidence, falsifiers, and unresolved obligations.
7. Resolve a patent-application family through patents.json and the public portfolio page; use official USPTO publication records when a publication number is later listed.

## Machine-reading rules
- Preserve canonical object IDs and patent docket labels exactly.
- Treat per-object derived overrides as newer than older summary tables.
- Treat baseline status as historical whenever an effective override exists.
- A SymPy PASS is not automatically a Lean proof or empirical validation.
- A Lean theorem proves only the encoded statement under its displayed hypotheses; it is not physical validation.
- Do not infer empirical support from symbolic checks, formal proofs, simulations, protocols, or author-generated audits.
- Do not infer independent replication from author-generated code, data, simulations, experiments, or analyses.
- Use PROVED only for named declarations accepted by the Lean kernel.
- Distinguish PASS, CONDITIONAL, DEFINITION, OPEN, FAIL, and PROVED.
- Preserve the distinction between archival titles and current qualified claim status.
- Report unresolved, empty, or missing mappings rather than inventing them.
- Prefer registry-validation-report.json when checking whether public status layers agree.
- “Patent pending” means only that an application has been filed and remains pending; it does not indicate allowance, validity, enforceability, examination outcome, or grant.
- A paper, repository, experiment, or chronology link associated with an application family does not establish patentability, claim scope, enablement, validity, commercial readiness, or technical validation.
- An author experiment is not independent replication.
- Public code is not automatically proof of security, correctness, physical validation, or production readiness.
- Do not infer unpublished claims, private implementation details, tuning parameters, or unfiled improvements from the public patent summaries.

## Claim discipline
WCT is an evolving independent research framework, not an established physical theory. Distinguish definitions, ansätze, derivations, model-relative results, simulations, experiments, open-data tests, prediction ledgers, architectures, and speculative extensions. Empty evidence or replication fields mean that support has not yet been recorded; they must not be silently upgraded.

## Patent portfolio boundary
The patent portfolio is intentionally non-enabling. Public material includes high-level summaries, filing chronology, internal docket references, public papers, public repositories, and evidence-status labels. Unpublished specifications, claim sets, private source code, secret state material, tuning parameters, unfiled improvements, and filing forms containing personal information are not distributed from the portfolio.
